findings.desc: signing-guard-mutation-proof-smoke.ts proves guard removal by regex-matching the SIGNABLE_SESSION_SOURCES Set literal in the COMPILED dist artifact (topology-critic-receipt.js), then mutating a copy in a temp dir. This is verified SAFE (real artifact is read-only throughout; mutation writes only to a fresh mkdtemp path cleaned in a finally block; byte-identical check at the end confirms no residue) and the brittleness is bounded (assert.ok(match) at line 25 fails loudly, not silently, if the build output shape ever changes the Set literal formatting) -- but it is still coupled to esbuild/tsc output formatting (e.g. quote style, whether the Set literal stays inline vs gets split across lines by a future compiler/minifier change) rather than to TS source AST. A more robust alternative would regex/parse the TS SOURCE (topology-critic-receipt.ts) instead of dist, or use a source-level import + monkey-patch of the Set at runtime instead of string surgery on compiled output. Not blocking: the current test passes, fails loudly on drift, and the constraint (prove BUILT guard removal without recompiling) is a real one under time pressure. Recording as advisory since a finding is more useful than a pass here.

packages/main/src/tasks/signing-guard-mutation-proof-smoke.ts:23-25,50 proves guard removal by regex-matching the SIGNABLE_SESSION_SOURCES Set literal in the COMPILED dist artifact (dist/core/topology-critic-receipt.js) and mutating a COPY in a fresh mkdtemp dir. Verified safe: the real dist file is only read (never written), the mutant is written only under the mkdtemp scratch dir which is rmSync-cleaned in a finally block, and the test itself asserts byte-identical restoration at the end (confirmed empirically by re-running the smoke: PASS, and diffing the real dist file before/after -- unchanged). The brittleness the author flagged is real but bounded, not silent: assert.ok(match, ...) at line 25 fails LOUDLY if the build output ever changes the Set literal formatting (e.g. minification, multi-line reformat), because the guard-presence check at line 21 and the set-literal regex at line 24 both run before any mutation; a shape change breaks the proof-of-concept itself rather than letting a weakened guard through silently. Suggestion (non-blocking): parsing/matching the TS SOURCE (topology-critic-receipt.ts) instead of the compiled dist output would decouple the proof from build-tool formatting choices, at the cost of not proving the SHIPPED artifact contains the guard. Recording as a finding rather than a pass per reviewer instruction; this is advisory, not a blocker.

CHK-002 userSees claims 'no test sets LATTICE_SESSION_ID to establish a signing identity', but at least 24 files under packages/main/src/tasks/ still directly assign process.env.LATTICE_SESSION_ID (or set it as a literal in an env object) to establish a signing/owner identity for CLI invocations under test, e.g. decision-doc-promotion-smoke.ts:48, delivery-context-pack-smoke.ts:482/489, evidence-refresh-smoke.ts:374/381, done-required-validation-smoke.ts:321/329, live-smoke-transcript-smoke.ts:827/1178/1185, frozen-claim-snapshot-hook-smoke.ts:70, plan-skeleton-smoke.ts:224/231, checklist-reload-hint-smoke.ts:64, proofstory-acceptance-basis-smoke.ts:68. This is the exact CHK-002 scope stated in plan.md (167 lines/29 files under packages/main/src/tasks/), and 29 files still contain the literal today. Since these tests dispatch/CLI-invoke under an explicit-env session id, any of them that exercise deriveRoleProvenance-gated commands would now hit the new CHK-001 guard and fail (or were silently routed around it), not migrated per plan. Fix: either complete the migration through the shared adapter-session-env.ts helper for all remaining files, or narrow CHK-002 userSees/scope to the subset actually migrated and file a follow-up for the rest.

CHK-003 userSees names the wrong smoke as its acceptance criterion: it says 'proofstory-topology-critic-smoke reports PASS, and reverting the CHK-001 guard makes it fail with an assertion naming the forgeable session source'. Running packages/main/dist/tasks/proofstory-topology-critic-smoke.js today exits 1 on an assertion at basis.status (expected complete, actual partial) that is unrelated to the signing-source guard and pre-existing (the file is byte-identical to main before this story touched it, per git diff main..HEAD~1 vs main). It never reaches the session-source guard or exclusion-approval code paths, so it cannot report PASS and cannot demonstrate the mutation-revert behaviour userSees describes. The actual verificationEvidence recorded for CHK-003 correctly points to two DIFFERENT, newly-added files instead (topology-signing-source-guard-smoke.ts and signing-guard-mutation-proof-smoke.ts, both of which do pass and do prove the guard mechanically), so the guard itself is adequately proven -- but the userSees text is stale/inaccurate and still promises an outcome the code does not produce. Fix: update CHK-003 userSees to name topology-signing-source-guard-smoke / signing-guard-mutation-proof-smoke (the tests actually used), not proofstory-topology-critic-smoke.

The scope-plan exclusion approver call site (proofstory.ts:550) is a bound signing role identical in risk profile to the critic (:565), per this story's own decision rationale, but its LEGITIMATE (accepted-session) path through topology_exclusion_approval_set is never exercised end to end anywhere in the current test suite. Its only production call sites in tests are inside proofstory-topology-critic-smoke.ts (lines ~505/538 for the negative/rejected cases, and the one positive-path call implied by the test flow), and that whole smoke test currently exits 1 at an assert.equal(basis.status, 'complete') check (see F-004) BEFORE it ever reaches the exclusion-approval flow. So a legitimate exclusion approver signing under a genuine host-adapter/generated-token session and an existing decisionRef has zero executed coverage right now -- the CHK-001 dispatcher's stated concern ("I have not seen it exercised end to end") is correct and unresolved. deriveRoleProvenance's source-gate logic is shared code covered generically by topology-signing-source-guard-smoke.ts for both roles, so the sessionSource check itself is proven for this role too, but the FULL production call site (authority check -> deriveRoleProvenance -> issueTopologyExclusionApproval -> store write -> verifyTopologyExclusionApproval) has never been driven with a real accepted session and a real exclusion. Fix: add a manual_transcript or automated test that dispatches lattice-review-scope-plan under a genuine host-adapter session, calls topology_exclusion_approval_set against a real exclusionRef from state.context.exclusions, and asserts it succeeds -- independent of fixing the unrelated basis-discovery defect blocking proofstory-topology-critic-smoke.
